description: Identifier tables used by the matching step: BiGG metabolite -> ChEBI and BiGG reaction -> EC number, each with the models whose annotations contain it. Only explicit annotations of the listed models are used; multiple or conflicting annotations are kept side by side.
licence_note: The tables are derived from the annotations of the models listed in `sources`; the terms of those models apply (BiGG licence; CC BY 4.0 for Human-GEM). Cite BiGG Models and Human-GEM when using them.
